ruleDefinitions.name: Fax Service DLL Search Order Hijack
ruleDefinitions.description: The Fax service attempts to load ualapi.dll, which is non-existent. An attacker can then (side)load their own malicious DLL using this service. Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\fxssvc\\\.exe$") AND ImageLoaded = RGX("ualapi\\\.dll$")) AND  NOT (ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\"))
